title: Question 13
passage:
Mind if I set my wet umbrella by your coat?
A. I took my coat off earlier. B. I think the rain stopped. C. I’d rather you use the umbrella stand.
passageZh:
你介意我把濕雨傘放在你外套旁嗎？
A. 我剛才就把外套脫下了。
B. 我想雨已經停了。
C. 我比較希望你把傘放到傘架上。
